scientific_integrity: The endpoint area formulas, full-depth isoperimetric quotient, and sharp optimal-cut-depth classification are proved analytically. Exact finite rational and optional convex-hull diagnostics are described separately; no finite computation substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only odd cycle dimensions at least five in the standard Euclidean embedding and the one-parameter symmetric valid-inequality cut. Known cap geometry and fractional volume are credited. Historical priority beyond inspected indexed and accessible sources remains provisional.
title: A sharp isoperimetric depth transition for the odd-cycle stable-set cut
